svg.title: Mano phase-driven learning loop
svg.desc: A living backlog feeds one approved small phase. Auto mode is optional; when enabled, it starts after approval, runs the needed planning skills, pauses for human decisions, and stops after the build. The human uses and reviews the result, and learning updates the backlog. Post-hooks add specialist checks and project automation. Optional owner mode supports parallel phase tracks over a shared backlog.
svg.text: You decide why, what, and how.
Mano helps plan and review one learning loop at a time.

text.tspan: Feel it • Show it • Gather feedback

g.text: After approval → runs needed skills → build • pauses for decisions
Routing only • Use branches/worktrees for isolation
